messages.content: The Irving manager confirmed I do not need to be there until 3:30 Tuesday. Reprice the Tuesday plan, check the hotel arrival setup and the rental counter hours, and compare it one last time with Monday night.

The Tuesday itinerary still fits. United 6:05 a.m. ORD-DFW arrives at 8:36 a.m.; the Wednesday return remains 6:35-9:02 p.m. The round trip is now $318, up $44 because of the return fare. Hyatt Place Dallas North/Addison is still $171 for Tuesday night, and the compact rental remains $116. With $14 estimated fuel, $18 tolls, and $46 ORD parking, the revised total is $683.
What time would I actually reach Irving now? I do not need hours sitting around before 3:30.

Allowing for the train to the DFW Rental Car Center, pickup, and a 15-25 minute drive, you should be in Irving around 10:00-10:20 a.m. You could work or have lunch nearby, then arrive for the inspection at 3:20. The flight timing is comfortable, but it does leave roughly five hours before the meeting.
That is fine. Verify the hotel. I may not get there until after dinner.

Hyatt Place Dallas North/Addison allows check-in from 3:00 p.m., and the front desk is staffed 24 hours. An arrival between 7:00 and 9:00 p.m. Tuesday is fine. The $171 rate includes taxes, self-parking is complimentary, and cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Monday, June 15; after that, one night's room and tax is charged.
And the rental? I was concerned the counter might close before I return it Wednesday.

The compact is with Avis at the DFW Rental Car Center, 2424 East 38th Street. The staffed counter is open Wednesday until 11:00 p.m., and vehicle returns at that location operate 24 hours. Your planned return around 4:10-4:30 p.m. is well within counter hours. Pickup Tuesday around 9:30 a.m. and return Wednesday at the same location are included in the $116 rate; it is pay at pickup and cancellable before pickup.
Run the Wednesday timing again from Plano, including the latest departure that does not make this reckless.

Leave the Plano site at 2:30 p.m. The drive to the DFW Rental Car Center should take 35-50 minutes, with extra time for traffic and a fuel stop. Return the car around 4:10-4:30, take the shuttle to the terminal, and be through security ahead of the 6:35 flight. A 3:20 p.m. departure from Plano is the latest workable point; later than that removes too much traffic and security margin.
How does Monday night price out right now? Complete total, not just airfare.

The Monday alternative is still $926 total: Southwest MDW-DAL round trip $296, two hotel nights $342, DAL rental $191, estimated fuel and tolls $28, and MDW parking $69. It departs Monday at 7:25 p.m., arrives DAL at 9:50, and gets you to the hotel around 10:50-11:00. Wednesday's return is 6:15-8:35 p.m. The Tuesday plan is now $683, so Monday costs $243 more and adds a hotel night, while avoiding Tuesday's 3:45 a.m. departure from home.
The Tuesday plan still wins. Before you book, confirm there is no issue arriving at the hotel after the Irving inspection and that the fare and room can still be bought at those numbers.

Confirmed. The inspection beginning at 3:30 should finish with ample time for the 25-35 minute drive to Addison, and the hotel's 24-hour desk removes any late-arrival issue. United is still available at $318 round trip in standard economy, nonrefundable with changes allowed subject to any fare difference. The Hyatt rate is still $171 with the Monday 6:00 p.m. cancellation deadline. Avis remains $116 with payment at pickup.
Book the United round trip, the Tuesday Hyatt night, and the compact at DFW. Keep the tolls and parking expectations with the final schedule.

Booked. United confirmation U6D9KF covers ORD-DFW Tuesday June 16, 6:05-8:36 a.m., and DFW-ORD Wednesday June 17, 6:35-9:02 p.m.; the $318 standard-economy fare is nonrefundable, with changes subject to fare difference. Hyatt Place Dallas North/Addison confirmation HP-583194 is $171 for Tuesday night, free self-parking, 24-hour front desk, and free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Monday June 15. Avis confirmation AV-741620 is a compact for $116, picked up around 9:30 a.m. Tuesday and returned Wednesday around 4:10-4:30 p.m. at the DFW Rental Car Center, 2424 East 38th Street; the counter is open until 11:00 p.m. and returns are available 24 hours. Leave home at 3:45 a.m. Tuesday and park at ORD around 4:35. Reach Irving around 10:00-10:20 and arrive for the 3:30 inspection by 3:20. On Wednesday, leave the hotel at 7:20 for the 8:00 Plano visit, depart Plano at 2:30, and treat 3:20 as the latest workable departure. Estimated trip total is $683, including $14 fuel, $18 tolls, and $46 ORD parking.
